sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CUSTOMER;
SELECT Name FROM GENRE ORDER BY Name;
SELECT MAX(UnitPrice) FROM TRACK;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CUSTOMER WHERE Country = 'Brazil';
SELECT firstname, lastname FROM EMPLOYEE WHERE title = 'Sales Support Agent';
SELECT SUM(T1.Total) FROM INVOICE AS T1 JOIN InvoiceLine AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.InvoiceId;
SELECT Title FROM TRACK WHERE NAME ILIKE '%Greatest%';
SELECT AVG(Milliseconds / 60) FROM TRACK;
SELECT Name FROM TRACK WHERE Milliseconds > 20000;
SELECT T2.Name, COUNT(*) FROM GENRE AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.GenreId = T2.GenreId GROUP BY T1.GenreId, T2.Name;
SELECT T2.Name FROM ALBUM AS T1 JOIN ARTIST AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId GROUP BY T2.ArtistId, T2.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.FirstName, T1.LastName, SUM(T2.Total) FROM CUSTOMER AS T1 JOIN INVOICE AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId GROUP BY T1.CustomerId, T1.FirstName, T1.LastName ORDER BY SUM(T2.Total) DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT T1.BillingCountry, SUM(T2.Total) FROM INVOICE AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.InvoiceId GROUP BY T1.BillingCountry ORDER BY SUM(T2.UnitPrice) DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INVOICE WHERE INVOICEDATE ILIKE '%2023%';
SELECT SUM(T2.UnitPrice), T1.Year FROM INVOICE AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.TrackId GROUP BY T1.Year ORDER BY T1.Year;
SELECT T2.Title FROM ALBUM AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.AlbumId WHERE T1.ArtistId = 1 AND T2.Name = 'AC/DC';
SELECT T2.Name FROM ALBUM AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.AlbumId WHERE T1.Title = 'Let There Be Rock';
SELECT T2.Name, COUNT(*) FROM TRACK AS T1 JOIN MEDIATYPE AS T2 ON T1.MediaTypeId = T2.MediaTypeId GROUP BY T2.Name;
SELECT AVG(T2.Total), T1.BillingCountry FROM INVOICE AS T1 JOIN INVOICELINE AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.InvoiceId GROUP BY T1.BillingCountry;
SELECT T2.FirstName, T2.LastName FROM EMPLOYEE AS T1 JOIN EMPLOYEE AS T2 ON T1.ReportsTo = T2.EmployeeId WHERE T1.FirstName = 'Nancy' AND T1.LastName = 'Edwards';
SELECT T1.FirstName, T1.LastName, COUNT(*) FROM EMPLOYEE AS T1 JOIN CUSTOMER AS T2 ON T1.EmployeeId = T2.CustomerId GROUP BY T1.EmployeeId, T1.FirstName, T1.LastName;
SELECT PlaylistId, Name FROM Playlist GROUP BY PlaylistId, Name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000;
SELECT T2.GenreName, AVG(T1.UnitPrice) FROM TRACK AS T1 JOIN GENRE AS T2 ON T1.GenreId = T2.GenreId GROUP BY T2.GenreName;
SELECT Composer FROM TRACK GROUP BY Composer, TRACKID HAVING COUNT(*) > 20;

SELECT T1.Name, SUM(T2.UnitPrice * T2.Quantity) FROM GENRE AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.GenreId = T2.GenreId WHERE T1.Title = 'sales' GROUP BY T1.Name ORDER BY SUM(T2.UnitPrice * T2.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.Name, COUNT(*) FROM TRACK AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.GenreId = T2.GenreId JOIN PlaylistTrack AS T3 ON T2.TrackId = T3.TrackId JOIN Playlist AS T4 ON T4.PlaylistId = T3.PlaylistId GROUP BY T1.Name, T2.GenreId, T3.TrackId, T4.PlaylistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT T1.firstname, T1.lastname FROM CUSTOMER AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.GenreId WHERE T2.Name IN (SELECT T2.Name FROM TRACK AS T2 JOIN GENRE AS T3 ON T2.GenreId = T3.GenreId WHERE T3.name = 'Jazz');

SELECT T1.FirstName, T1.LastName, SUM(T2.revenue) FROM CUSTOMER AS T1 JOIN INVOICE AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId JOIN EMPLOYEE AS T3 ON T1.SupportRepId = T3.EmployeeId GROUP BY T1.FirstName, T1.LastName;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRACK WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT TrackId FROM INVOICE);
SELECT T1.Title, (T2.Milliseconds + T2.Bytes) / 60 FROM ALBUM AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.AlbumId ORDER BY (T2.Milliseconds + T2.Bytes) DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT T2.Name FROM GENRE AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.GenreId = T2.GenreId GROUP BY T2.Name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRACK WHERE MILLISECONDS / 60000 > 5;
SELECT firstname, lastname, hiredate FROM EMPLOYEE ORDER BY birthdate LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.firstname, T1.lastname FROM CUSTOMER AS T1 JOIN INVOICE AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId GROUP BY T1.CustomerId, T1.firstname, T1.lastname HAVING SUM(T2.Total) > (SELECT AVG(T2.Total) FROM INVOICE);

SELECT T1.Year, T2.GenreName, T3.Quantity FROM GENRE AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.GenreID = T2.GenreID JOIN INVOICELINE AS T3 ON T3.InvoiceId = T2.TrackId GROUP BY T1.Year, T2.GenreName, T3.Quantity ORDER BY T1.Year;

SELECT MONTH, SUM(T2.UnitPrice), MONTH - 1 FROM TRACK AS T1 JOIN INVOICELINE AS T2 ON T1.TrackId = T2.TrackId WHERE T1.MediaTypeId = 1 AND T1.GenreId = 0 AND T2.Quantity > 0 AND YEAR(T2.InvoiceDate) = 2025 GROUP BY MONTH ORDER BY MONTH;
SELECT T1.Name, CAST(SUM(T2.UnitPrice * 1.0 / T1.MediaTypeId) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(T1.MediaTypeId) FROM GENRE AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.GenreId = T2.GenreId GROUP BY T1.MediaTypeId, T1.Name;
SELECT T1.firstname, T1.lastname FROM CUSTOMER AS T1 JOIN INVOICE AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId WHERE T2.InvoiceDate >= '2021-01-01' AND T2.InvoiceDate <= '2025-12-31';
SELECT T1.Name, AVG(T2.Milliseconds / T2.Quantity) FROM TRACK AS T1 JOIN INVOICELINE AS T2 ON T1.TrackId = T2.TrackId GROUP BY T1.Name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10;
SELECT T1.firstname, T1.lastname, T2.firstname, T2.lastname FROM EMPLOYEE AS T1 JOIN EMPLOYEE AS T2 ON T1.EmployeeID = T2.ReportsTo;
SELECT MONTH, SUM(revenue) FROM invoice GROUP BY MONTH ORDER BY MONTH;
SELECT PlaylistId FROM PlaylistTrack EXCEPT SELECT PlaylistId FROM TRACK;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countries;
SELECT name FROM countries WHERE region = 'South Asia';
SELECT capital_city FROM countries WHERE name = 'Japan';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countries WHERE income_group = 'Low income';
SELECT population FROM countries WHERE name = 'India';
SELECT name, population FROM countries ORDER BY population DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT SUM(population), income_group FROM country_stats GROUP BY income_group;
SELECT gdp_per_capita_usd FROM country_stats WHERE YEAR = 2023 ORDER BY gdp_per_capita_usd DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(population), YEAR FROM country_stats GROUP BY YEAR ORDER BY YEAR;
SELECT T1.name FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.life_expectancy_years > 70 AND T2.year = 2023;
SELECT unemployment_pct FROM country_stats WHERE iso3 = 'Germany' ORDER BY YEAR;
SELECT AVG(fertility_rate), region FROM country_stats WHERE YEAR = 2023 GROUP BY region;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country_stats WHERE gdp_per_capita_usd > 1000000;
SELECT T1.name FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T1.region = 'Europe & Central Asia' AND T2.fertility_rate = (SELECT MIN(fertility_rate) FROM country_stats);
SELECT YEAR, gdp_usd FROM country_stats WHERE YEAR = 2000 UNION SELECT YEAR, gdp_usd FROM country_stats WHERE YEAR = 2023;
SELECT T1.name FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.internet_users_pct > 70 AND T2.year = 2023;
SELECT population - population FROM countries WHERE YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2023;
SELECT name, gain FROM country_stats WHERE life_expectancy_years BETWEEN 2000 AND 2023 ORDER BY gain DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT SUM(gdp_per_capita_usd), income_group FROM country_stats WHERE YEAR = 2023 GROUP BY income_group ORDER BY SUM(gdp_per_capita_usd) DESC;
SELECT T1.name FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.gdp_per_capita_usd > (SELECT AVG(gdp_per_capita_usd) FROM country_stats);
SELECT AVG(life_expectancy_years) FROM country_stats WHERE YEAR = 2023;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country_stats WHERE population < (SELECT MIN(population) FROM country_stats WHERE YEAR = 2010);
SELECT name, region, life_expectancy_years FROM country_stats WHERE life_expectancy_years < 60 AND YEAR = 2023;
SELECT SUM(population), region FROM country_stats WHERE YEAR = 2023 GROUP BY region;
SELECT iso3 FROM countries WHERE gdp_per_capita_usd = 0;
SELECT gdp_per_capita_usd - LAG(gdp_per_capita_usd) OVER (ORDER BY year) FROM country_stats WHERE iso3 = 'France';
SELECT T1.income_group, T2.name, T2.gdp_per_capita_usd FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.year = 2023 ORDER BY T2.gdp_per_capita_usd DESC;
SELECT T1.region, AVG(T2.urban_population_pct) FROM country_stats AS T1 JOIN countries AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T1.year = 2023 GROUP BY T1.region;
SELECT iso3 FROM country_stats WHERE internet_users_pct < 10 AND internet_users_pct > 50 AND YEAR = 2010;
SELECT gdp_per_capita_usd, life_expectancy_years FROM country_stats WHERE YEAR = 2023;
SELECT T1.name, T2.iso3, T2.population FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.year = 2023 ORDER BY T2.population DESC, T1.region;
SELECT T1.region, T2.name, T1.unemployment_pct FROM country_stats AS T1 JOIN countries AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T1.year = 2020 ORDER BY T1.unemployment_pct DESC;
SELECT T1.region, T2.year, AVG(T3.lifespansys) FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 GROUP BY T1.region, T2.year;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE species = 'Gentoo';
SELECT DISTINCT island FROM penguins;
SELECT MAX(body_mass_g) FROM penguins;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'unknown';
SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins;
SELECT COUNT(*), species FROM penguins GROUP BY species;
SELECT AVG(body_mass_g) FROM penguins;
SELECT COUNT(*), island, YEAR FROM penguins GROUP BY island, YEAR;
SELECT AVG(bill_length_mm) FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'male' UNION SELECT AVG(bill_length_mm) FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'female';
SELECT species FROM penguins GROUP BY species ORDER BY AVG(flipper_length_mm) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT MIN(bill_depth_mm), MAX(bill_depth_mm), species FROM penguins GROUP BY species;
SELECT island FROM penguins GROUP BY island ORDER BY COUNT(species) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT AVG(body_mass_g), sex FROM penguins WHERE species <> 'unknown' GROUP BY sex, species;
SELECT species FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'male' AND body_mass_g > (SELECT MIN(body_mass_g) FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'female');
SELECT COUNT(species) FROM penguins WHERE bill_weight_mm > (SELECT AVG(bill_weight_mm) FROM penguins);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE species = 'Gentoo' AND island = 'Biscoe';
SELECT COUNT(*), species, YEAR FROM penguins GROUP BY species, YEAR ORDER BY species, YEAR;
SELECT island FROM penguins GROUP BY island HAVING COUNT(species) > 1;
SELECT AVG(bill_length_mm / bill_depth_mm), species FROM penguins GROUP BY species;
SELECT species, island, body_mass_g FROM penguins ORDER BY body_mass_g DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT species, AVG(body_mass_g) FROM penguins WHERE YEAR = 2007 INTERSECT SELECT species, AVG(body_mass_g) FROM penguins WHERE YEAR = 2009;
SELECT species, island FROM penguins GROUP BY species, island, AVG(flipper_length_mm) ORDER BY AVG(flipper_length_mm) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT rank, species, AVG(bill_length_mm) FROM penguins GROUP BY species, rank ORDER BY AVG(bill_length_mm) DESC;
SELECT AVG(body_mass_g) FROM penguins;
